about: A42 search, first and second passes (SO70 T213 and T214, October 11, 2026). Produced by A42_Rule_Search.py and compiled by A42_Compile_Results.py; see A42_Search_README.md.

classes.stops or stays small: fewer than 300 updates before no match is left or the run ends
classes.tree: every update has one direct cause, so the causal order is a tree (dimension 1)
classes.exponential: updates per generation grow by more than 10 percent per generation over the second half of the run
classes.polynomial: the rest; updates per generation grow as a power p of the generation, a volume dimension of about p + 1

runs.scan: up to 3,000 updates, 400 generations, 60,000 relations or 8 seconds per rule
runs.long: 27 rules up to 20,000 updates or 60 seconds, with a size series of intervals

intervals: root: from the root event to the six events with the largest pasts; mid: from the event 30 percent of the way up with the largest interval; series: one top event, bottom tips at growing depth; at least 120 elements (60 in a series)
four_dimensional_criterion: Myrheim-Meyer, midpoint and longest-chain readings all between 3.5 and 4.5 on the same interval
